# Purpose

Counts participants retained at each step from an eInsight record to the paired outcome
sample and the discharge sample, with the number excluded at each step, and draws Figure 5.7.
The unit is the participant (`client_system_id`). A participant is retained at a step if any
of their records meets it, and each step requires the one before it, so the exclusions sum
to the difference between the first and last box.

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(knitr)
})

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, knitr.kable.NA = "", scipen = 999)
```

```{r}
#| label: config
# Defaults are used when running chunks interactively; non-empty YAML params take precedence when rendering.
defaults <- list(
  path_all_data = "/Users/cristin/Dropbox-CWS/Cristin Young/CYBHI Project/Rebecca and Tristan and Cristin/EInsight Data/demographic_discharge_clean.csv",
  output_dir = "output/fig507",
  data_through = "",
  suppress_n = 60,
  shareable = FALSE
)
cfg <- modifyList(defaults, if (exists("params")) discard(as.list(params), \(p) identical(p, "")) else list())

SUPPRESS_N  <- as.integer(cfg$suppress_n)
SHAREABLE   <- isTRUE(as.logical(cfg$shareable))
RENDER_MODE <- if (SHAREABLE) "SHAREABLE" else "INTERNAL"
# Episodes, assessments, and discharges dated after the extract date are ignored; with no date set, nothing is filtered.
DATA_THROUGH <- if (nzchar(cfg$data_through)) as.Date(cfg$data_through) else as.Date(Inf)

ID_COLS <- c("client_system_id", "primary_client_system_id", "provider_system_id")

# Columns that hold each side of an initial/follow-up pair. Each row of all_data is one
# measure for one episode. The same-measure check runs only if both MEASURE_COLS exist.
SCORE_COLS   <- c(pre = "pre_score", post = "post_score")
DATE_COLS    <- c(pre = "pre_completion_date", post = "post_completion_date")
MEASURE_COLS <- c(pre = "trimmed_pre_assessment_name", post = "trimmed_post_assessment_name")

# One row per box, in order. `flag` is the participant-level indicator computed below;
# `exclusion` labels the box for participants lost on the way into that stage.
STAGES <- tribble(
  ~flag,        ~label,                                  ~exclusion,
  "served",     "Participants with an eInsight record",  NA,
  "enrolled",   "Enrolled in an EBP/CDEP intervention",  "Not enrolled in an intervention",
  "initial",    "At least one initial assessment",       "No initial assessment",
  "followup",   "Follow-up on the same measure",         "No follow-up on the same measure",
  "paired",     "Paired analytic sample",                "Pair not valid",
  "discharged", "Discharge sample",                      "No documented discharge"
)
HIGHLIGHT_FLAG <- "paired"   # box drawn in the accent color; its share of those served goes in the title

# Sub-counts printed inside an exclusion box: participants lost at `flag` who also meet `note_flag`.
NOTES <- tribble(
  ~flag,      ~note_flag,           ~note,
  "initial",  "no_measure_program", "In programs that collect no measures",
  "followup", "still_active",       "Still active at extraction"
)

# Why a pair with a follow-up record is not valid (row-level QA table).
INVALID_REASONS <- c(
  missing_score     = "Initial or follow-up score missing",
  followup_first    = "Follow-up dated before initial",
  different_measure = "Different measure or version"
)

# DHCS Visual Identity Guidelines palette.
COL <- list(accent = "#2D6E8D", ink = "#17315A", edge = "#696A6A", quiet = "#515253", fill = "#ECEEF0")
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# Copied from sq403_satisfaction_predictors.qmd so both scripts read and format data identically.
id_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) x <- format(x, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, digits = 15)
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

to_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as_date(x))
  as_date(parse_date_time(as.character(x),
                          orders = c("Ymd", "mdY", "Ymd HMS", "mdY HMS", "Ymd HM", "mdY HM"),
                          quiet = TRUE))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 1) if_else(is.na(x), NA_character_, sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f%%"), 100 * x))
fmt_n   <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
fmt_n_qa <- function(n) if_else(SHAREABLE & !is.na(n) & n > 0 & n < SUPPRESS_N, paste0("<", SUPPRESS_N), fmt_n(n))

save_table <- function(df, name) {
  if (nzchar(cfg$output_dir)) {
    dir.create(cfg$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write_csv(df, file.path(cfg$output_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), na = "")
  }
  invisible(df)
}

read_any <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !nzchar(path)) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  switch(tolower(tools::file_ext(path)),
    rds     = readRDS(path),
    csv     = readr::read_csv(path, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
                              na = c("", "NA", "NULL")),
    parquet = arrow::read_parquet(path),
    sav     = haven::read_sav(path) |> haven::as_factor() |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character)),
    stop("Unsupported file type: ", path, call. = FALSE))
}

check_cols <- function(df, cols, name) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing)) stop(name, " is missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

# New in this script
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
fmt_count <- function(n) if_else(is.na(n), NA_character_, fmt_n_qa(n))   # NA stays NA (blank in tables)
in_window <- function(d) !is.na(d) & d <= DATA_THROUGH
```

# Load and prepare

```{r}
#| label: load
all_data <- read_any(cfg$path_all_data)
check_cols(all_data, c("client_system_id", "provider_system_id", "intervention_name", "intervention_start",
                       "intervention_end", SCORE_COLS, DATE_COLS), "all_data")

has_measure_cols <- all(MEASURE_COLS %in% names(all_data))

ad <- all_data |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    across(any_of(ID_COLS), id_chr),
    across(all_of(c("intervention_start", "intervention_end", unname(DATE_COLS))), to_date),
    pre_num   = num(.data[[SCORE_COLS[["pre"]]]]),
    post_num  = num(.data[[SCORE_COLS[["post"]]]]),
    pre_date  = .data[[DATE_COLS[["pre"]]]],
    post_date = .data[[DATE_COLS[["post"]]]]
  ) |>
  # Episodes that start after the extract date are outside the reporting window.
  filter(!is.na(client_system_id), is.na(intervention_start) | intervention_start <= DATA_THROUGH)

# Remove eInsight test/demo accounts (same rule as the satisfaction scripts). Blank provider_id values are kept.
n_demo <- 0L
if ("provider_id" %in% names(ad)) {
  is_demo <- coalesce(str_detect(as.character(ad$provider_id), "DEMO"), FALSE)
  n_demo  <- sum(is_demo)
  ad      <- ad[!is_demo, ]
}
```

# Flow

```{r}
#| label: flags
# Row level. Each flag requires the one before it, so the participant-level flags nest too.
rows <- ad |>
  mutate(
    served     = TRUE,
    enrolled   = !is.na(str_squish(intervention_name)),
    initial    = enrolled & (!is.na(pre_num) | in_window(pre_date)),
    followup   = initial & (!is.na(post_num) | in_window(post_date)),
    missing_score     = followup & (is.na(pre_num) | is.na(post_num)),
    followup_first    = followup & coalesce(post_date < pre_date, FALSE),
    different_measure = followup & has_measure_cols &
                          coalesce(.data[[MEASURE_COLS[["pre"]]]] != .data[[MEASURE_COLS[["post"]]]], FALSE),
    paired     = followup & !if_any(all_of(names(INVALID_REASONS))),
    discharged = paired & in_window(intervention_end),
    open_episode = enrolled & !in_window(intervention_end)
  ) |>
  # A program "collects no measures" if none of its enrolled records has an initial assessment.
  mutate(program_no_measures = !any(initial), .by = provider_system_id)

clients <- rows |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(STAGES$flag), any),
    no_measure_program = any(enrolled) && all(program_no_measures[enrolled]),
    still_active       = any(open_episode),
    .by = client_system_id
  )
stage_mat <- as.matrix(clients[STAGES$flag])
stopifnot(all(stage_mat[, -1] <= stage_mat[, -ncol(stage_mat)]))   # stages nest

# Stage at which each participant is lost (NA = retained to the last box).
clients <- clients |>
  mutate(lost_at = STAGES$flag[if_else(rowSums(!stage_mat) > 0, max.col(!stage_mat, ties.method = "first"), NA_integer_)])

flow <- STAGES |>
  mutate(n = colSums(stage_mat), excluded = lag(n) - n, pct_of_served = n / first(n)) |>
  left_join(
    NOTES |> mutate(note_n = map2_int(flag, note_flag, \(f, nf) sum(clients[[nf]] & clients$lost_at %in% f))),
    by = "flag"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: flow-table
flow |>
  transmute(Stage = label, n = fmt_count(n), `% of served` = fmt_pct(pct_of_served),
            `Excluded before this stage` = exclusion, `n excluded` = fmt_count(excluded),
            Note = note, `n (note)` = fmt_count(note_n)) |>
  kable(caption = sprintf("Participant flow (%s render)", RENDER_MODE))

flow |>
  mutate(across(c(n, excluded, note_n), fmt_count), pct_of_served = fmt_pct(pct_of_served), render_mode = RENDER_MODE) |>
  save_table("fig507_participant_flow")
```

```{r}
#| label: recoverable-check
#| results: asis
# A masked exclusion can be recovered by subtracting the boxes on either side of it.
recoverable <- flow |> filter(SHAREABLE, excluded > 0, excluded < SUPPRESS_N)
if (nrow(recoverable)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n::: {.callout-warning}\nMasked exclusion counts can be recovered by subtracting adjacent boxes: %s. Decide how to present these before sharing the figure.\n:::\n",
              paste(recoverable$exclusion, collapse = "; ")))
}
```

# Figure 5.7

```{r}
#| label: figure
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8.2
BOX   <- list(main_x = c(0, 4.4), excl_x = c(5.4, 10), half_h = 0.3, step = 1.25)
main_mid <- mean(BOX$main_x)

boxes <- flow |>
  mutate(
    y        = -(row_number() - 1) * BOX$step,
    y_excl   = y + BOX$step / 2,
    hi       = flag == HIGHLIGHT_FLAG,
    n_line   = if_else(row_number() == 1, paste("n =", fmt_count(n)),
                       sprintf("n = %s (%s of those served)", fmt_count(n), fmt_pct(pct_of_served))),
    excl_line = paste("n =", fmt_count(excluded)),
    note_line = if_else(is.na(note), NA_character_, sprintf("%s: n = %s", note, fmt_count(note_n))),
    y_text    = y_excl - if_else(is.na(note), 0.1, 0)   # centre two-line boxes
  )
excl   <- boxes |> filter(!is.na(exclusion))
arrow_ <- arrow(length = unit(0.16, "cm"), type = "closed")
hi_box <- boxes |> filter(hi)

fig <- ggplot() +
  # connectors
  geom_segment(data = excl, aes(x = main_mid, xend = main_mid, y = y + BOX$step - BOX$half_h, yend = y + BOX$half_h),
               colour = COL$edge, arrow = arrow_, arrow.fill = COL$edge) +
  geom_segment(data = excl, aes(x = main_mid, xend = BOX$excl_x[1], y = y_excl, yend = y_excl),
               colour = COL$edge, arrow = arrow_, arrow.fill = COL$edge) +
  # stage boxes
  geom_rect(data = boxes, aes(xmin = BOX$main_x[1], xmax = BOX$main_x[2], ymin = y - BOX$half_h, ymax = y + BOX$half_h,
                              fill = hi, colour = hi, linewidth = hi)) +
  geom_text(data = boxes, aes(x = main_mid, y = y + 0.1, label = label), fontface = "bold", colour = COL$ink, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(data = boxes, aes(x = main_mid, y = y - 0.12, label = n_line), colour = COL$ink, size = 3.6) +
  # exclusion boxes
  geom_rect(data = excl, aes(xmin = BOX$excl_x[1], xmax = BOX$excl_x[2], ymin = y_excl - BOX$half_h - 0.08,
                             ymax = y_excl + BOX$half_h + 0.08), fill = "white", colour = COL$edge, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = excl, aes(x = BOX$excl_x[1] + 0.15, y = y_text + 0.2, label = exclusion),
            hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = COL$ink, size = 3.4) +
  geom_text(data = excl, aes(x = BOX$excl_x[1] + 0.15, y = y_text, label = excl_line), hjust = 0, colour = COL$ink, size = 3.4) +
  geom_text(data = excl |> filter(!is.na(note_line)), aes(x = BOX$excl_x[1] + 0.15, y = y_excl - 0.2, label = note_line),
            hjust = 0, colour = COL$quiet, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "white", `TRUE` = COL$fill), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = COL$edge, `TRUE` = COL$accent), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.4, `TRUE` = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(BOX$main_x[1], BOX$excl_x[2]), clip = "off") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Paired outcome data cover %s of participants served", fmt_pct(hi_box$pct_of_served)),
       caption = if (is.finite(DATA_THROUGH)) paste("Data through", format(DATA_THROUGH, "%B %e, %Y")) else NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = COL$ink, margin = margin(b = 12)),
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = COL$quiet), plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12))
fig

if (nzchar(cfg$output_dir)) {
  ggsave(file.path(cfg$output_dir, sprintf("fig507_participant_flow_%s.png", RENDER_MODE)),
         fig, width = 8, height = 8.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

# Data quality

```{r}
#| label: qa
tibble(
  Check = c("Rows read", "Test/demo account rows removed", "Rows analyzed", "Same-measure check applied"),
  Value = c(fmt_n(nrow(all_data)), fmt_n_qa(n_demo), fmt_n(nrow(ad)),
            if (has_measure_cols) "Yes" else paste("No:", paste(setdiff(MEASURE_COLS, names(all_data)), collapse = ", "), "not in file"))
) |> kable()

# Reasons a pair with a follow-up record is not valid (a pair can have more than one).
invalid_tab <- rows |>
  filter(followup) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(names(INVALID_REASONS)), sum), pairs_with_followup = n()) |>
  pivot_longer(-pairs_with_followup, names_to = "reason", values_to = "pairs") |>
  transmute(Reason = INVALID_REASONS[reason], Pairs = fmt_n_qa(pairs),
            `% of pairs with a follow-up` = if_else(SHAREABLE & pairs > 0 & pairs < SUPPRESS_N, "Suppr.", fmt_pct(pairs / pairs_with_followup)))
kable(invalid_tab, caption = "Why initial/follow-up pairs were not valid (measure-level rows)")
save_table(mutate(invalid_tab, render_mode = RENDER_MODE), "fig507_invalid_pair_reasons")

# Programs with enrolled participants and no initial assessments.
rows |>
  filter(enrolled) |>
  summarise(participants = n_distinct(client_system_id), no_measures = first(program_no_measures), .by = provider_system_id) |>
  summarise(Programs = n(), `Programs with no initial assessments` = sum(no_measures),
            `Their enrolled participants` = fmt_n_qa(sum(participants[no_measures]))) |>
  kable(caption = "Programs that collected no outcome measures")
```
